description: FREE: poll a generation job submitted by the paid generate tools. Returns status/progress; once complete AND the deferred payment has settled, returns the download URLs. A failed generation reports charged=false. Look up by job_id, or by idempotency_key + payer if the job_id was lost. [Free — no payment required.]

idempotency_key.description: Alternate lookup key: the idempotency_key passed to the original generate call. Requires payer.

job_id.description: Job id returned by a generate tool

payer.description: x402 payer address the original generate call used — required when looking up by idempotency_key (scopes the key to its owner).

name: get_generation_status
title: Get Generation Job Status
